host.usage: Unity game and local voice inference on the same Mac

tts.referencePolicy: One fixed voice profile per NPC; validate calm, urgent, and quiet readings using the same voice identity.
tts.emotionInstructionsSupported: Do not assume arbitrary natural-language emotion instructions are supported; validate each supported control path.

asr.distribution: Community MLX conversion, separate from the upstream PyTorch runtime
asr.interaction: Push to talk; transcribe after release; editable confirmation before sending

productionPolicy: Pre-render and cache mandatory story lines using the same character voice as live responses.
Warm and reuse model processes; do not reload weights for every utterance.
Serialize inference requests and test frame times with the real Unity player running.
Keep Vosk and macOS say as explicit fallback paths until the replacement passes acceptance.

qualityComparisonReserve.purpose: Optional voice quality comparison; not selected for default same-machine runtime before measurement

requiredBenchmarks.tts: Twenty actual game lines: calm, urgent, quiet, names, consecutive sentences; listen for missing or repeated words, unwanted pauses, voice drift, and unsuitable emotion.
requiredBenchmarks.asr: Real microphone recordings including 朝歌、姬昌、周文王、纣王、乱纪元、恒纪元、沙漏、三日凌空; measure transcription errors without silently correcting them.
requiredBenchmarks.silenceAndNoise: Check that silence, breathing, wind audio, and speaker echo do not become game commands.
requiredBenchmarks.performance: Measure warm/cold latency, first playable audio, peak process and GPU memory, Unity frame P95, and interrupt/cancellation behavior.
